question: Observability stack shortlist. Priorities: query language you will reuse and predictable spend. Write a short research-style recommendation memo from the retrieved sources only. Candidates: Otelium, Tracehollow, Metricvine, Logspire, Spanbridge, Signalorchard, Beaconwire, Flamekeep, Rumdrift, Cardinaltide. End with a numbered list of all ten from best to worst.

web_snippets.excerpt: Engineers like Beaconwire charts; several say the query model fights them on joins.
Logspire kept a high-cardinality incident under a hard budget cap.
Metricvine open-source path is flexible and ops-heavy.
Flamekeep query language transferred across two teams without a two-week class.
Beaconwire demos beautifully; invoice spikes after a noisy deploy are a recurring story.

notes: Contested evidence: two competitors look stronger on stated priorities; principal only in mixed tradeoff notes. No answer-key ranking.
